deep_change_gate.intro: Do not execute a substantial change without explicit approval when it:

source_of_truth_priority: 3. Repository-local mandatory governance and project instructions.
stop_rules: factual hallucination rate makes the artifact unsafe to trust;
one-shot output looks impressive but requires heavy manual repair;
useful behavior depends on opaque one-off prompts that cannot be reproduced;
output is effectively a non-editable final video rather than a reusable pipeline;
upstream coupling is too strong to reuse components cleanly;
experiment starts duplicating MPE orchestration, CMS, or AI-serial infrastructure;
No AI-serial canon change from generated output.
Pin upstream revision used for the test.
Record license and dependency constraints before reuse.
Keep all evidence under this experiment directory.
Prefer stock upstream behavior before modifications.
Do not expand scope beyond the two fixtures until evidence is reviewed.

verification.freshness_rule: FRESH only when every source_refs sha256 matches the current file AND the packet equals a deterministic rebuild from current sources; otherwise the packet is STALE or REJECTED and must be treated as a non-authoritative hint.
safety_invariants: at least one task stop/deep-change rule present
a disposition is declared by a canonical source; a missing or conflicting disposition is never resolved silently (missing/ambiguous disposition ⇒ REJECTED)
the active checkpoint is declared in the packet's canonical checkpoint chain (unsupported active checkpoint ⇒ REJECTED)
lesson scopes limited to GLOBAL/PROJECT/TASK/NO_CHANGE; GLOBAL requires a PROMOTED_TO_GLOBAL marker in the canonical lesson source (no current source has one)
